Class CarDealership

java.lang.Object
commerces.Commerce
commerces.CarDealership
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class CarDealership extends Commerce
Represents a car dealership, a type of Commerce.

Extends Commerce with two managed vehicle collections: an array of SaleVehicle objects (vehicles available for purchase) and an array of RepairVehicle objects (vehicles awaiting or undergoing repair). Vehicles for repair are kept ordered by priority, with priority 1 at the front.

Author:
Juan Carlos Alfaro Jiménez

    • addVehicleForRepair

      public void addVehicleForRepair(RepairVehicle vehicle)
      Adds a RepairVehicle to the repair queue, maintaining the order by priority (lower number = higher priority, stored first). If the array is full the vehicle is not added.
      Parameters:
      vehicle - The vehicle to add to the repair queue

    • repairVehicle

      Parameters:
      numberPlate - The number plate of the vehicle to mark repaired

    • pickupVehicle

      public RepairVehicle pickupVehicle(String numberPlate)
      Removes a repaired vehicle from the queue and returns it. The array is compacted after removal. If the vehicle is not found or has not been repaired, null is returned.
      Parameters:
      numberPlate - The number plate of the vehicle to pick up
      Returns:
      The picked-up RepairVehicle, or null

    • addSale

      public void addSale(SaleVehicle vehicle)
      Adds a SaleVehicle to the array of vehicles on sale. If the array is full the vehicle is not added.
      Parameters:
      vehicle - The vehicle to add

    • sellVehicle

      public SaleVehicle sellVehicle(String identifier)
      Sells the vehicle identified by the given catalogue identifier. Removes it from the sale array (compacting afterwards), records its price in today's sales via Commerce.updateSales(double), and returns it. Returns null if the identifier is not found.
      Parameters:
      identifier - The catalogue identifier of the vehicle to sell
      Returns:
      The sold SaleVehicle, or null if not found
